answer: Day after day the rind man rubs the wheels with oil and a scrap of linen, working the oil into the rind till it shines like polished wood. Rind butter butter packer curd writ is the rubbing: a writ butter butter packers sign after packing dairy audits. The opal opens the rubbing, the anchor closes the linen, the zenith proves the wheels. A cheat must do 263 false rubbings and 263 false shinings.
